from dspy.adapters.types.tool import ToolCalls

# Case 1: canonical dict with tool_calls
c1 = ToolCalls(tool_calls=[{'name': 'foo', 'args': {'a': 1}}])
print('canonical dict:', ToolCalls.validate_input({'tool_calls': [{'name': 'foo', 'args': {'a': 1}}]}))

# Case 2: single object without tool_calls key
print('single object:', ToolCalls.validate_input({'name': 'foo', 'args': {'a': 1}}))

# Case 3: bare list
print('bare list:', ToolCalls.validate_input([{'name': 'foo', 'args': {'a': 1}}, {'name': 'bar', 'args': {'b': 2}}]))

# Case 4: JSON string - canonical
print('json canonical:', ToolCalls.validate_input('{\"tool_calls\": [{\"name\": \"foo\", \"args\": {\"a\": 1}}]}'))

# Case 5: JSON string - single object
print('json single:', ToolCalls.validate_input('{\"name\": \"foo\", \"args\": {\"a\": 1}}'))

# Case 6: JSON string - bare list
print('json list:', ToolCalls.validate_input('[{\"name\": \"foo\", \"args\": {\"a\": 1}}, {\"name\": \"bar\", \"args\": {\"b\": 2}}]'))

# Case 7: non-JSON string
print('non-json string:', repr(ToolCalls.validate_input('hello world')))

# Case 8: ToolCalls instance
print('instance:', ToolCalls.validate_input(c1))

# Now verify that construction works end-to-end from all these forms
print()
print('construct from canonical:', ToolCalls(tool_calls=[{'name': 'foo', 'args': {'a': 1}}]))
print('construct from single obj:', ToolCalls(**{'name': 'foo', 'args': {'a': 1}}))
print('construct from list:', ToolCalls(**{'tool_calls': [{'name': 'foo', 'args': {'a': 1}}]}))
